why_this_file_exists: The gate ratchet needs a list of unproven gates, each with a reason and a
slot. That list changes every time a gate closes — which made it a
recurring edit to tools/label_gates.py, and the repository's own churn
guard was right to object: a source file edited once per closed gate is a
file whose data does not belong in it.
So the backlog is data with ONE authority, and closing a gate edits this
file instead of the checker. The checker's logic stops changing entirely.
